items.title: We quote the entire property, not just the rental unit
text: Crawl spaces, sheds, lean-tos and boathouses are included in the same assessment. On converted cottage properties these frequently hold more volume than the interior, and excluding them from the original quote is what turns a single job into two visits.

items.title: We account for damp and weather-damaged contents at the quote stage
text: Furniture stored through unheated winters, mildewed mattresses, rusted appliances and deteriorated cardboard require more time and labour to handle safely. We identify this during the walkthrough and build it into your price rather than raising it mid-job.

items.title: We document every property management cleanout with dated photographs
text: You receive a timestamped photo set and a written record of everything removed from the property. Landlords use this documentation to support deposit disputes and damage claims at the Landlord and Tenant Board. It is included on every job at no additional cost.

items.title: We work with single-property owners as readily as portfolios
text: There are few property management firms operating this far north, and most of our Georgina clients own one or two rental properties — an inherited cottage, a converted family home, or a suite within their own residence. We apply no minimum job size and no premium for small bookings.

items.title: We confirm road and driveway access before dispatch
text: Unassumed roads, narrow lakeside lanes and soft spring ground all affect which vehicle we send. Confirming these details at booking allows us to assign the correct truck and complete the job as scheduled.

items.title: We charge no franchise overhead
text: National junk removal brands build royalty fees into every quote and frequently add distance charges for properties north of Newmarket. As an independent operator we do neither, which is why our property management cleanout pricing in Georgina remains 30–50% below the franchise alternatives.

blocks.text: PROPERTY MANAGEMENT CLEANOUT PRICING
Property Management Cleanout Cost in Georgina
The Honest Property Management Cleanout Cost Answer

b: Your property management cleanout cost in Georgina is determined by two factors: the volume of material to be removed and the condition it is in.

c: A purpose-built apartment returned in reasonable order is a short job. A converted cottage rental containing furniture across multiple rooms, appliances left uncleaned, a full crawl space and a shed of accumulated yard waste requires substantially more time and labour, and we price it accordingly.

Three factors never affect your quote. Location within the municipality — properties in Pefferlaw and Udora are priced identically to those in central Keswick, as travel is our cost to absorb. Urgency — a rental unit turnover booked for tomorrow costs the same as one booked for next month. Portfolio size — owners of a single cottage rental pay the same per-unit rate as landlords holding multiple properties. We confirm your price in writing at the walkthrough, and that figure is what appears on your invoice.

items.q: Can you handle cottages and seasonal rental properties in Georgina?
a: Yes. Cleanouts can include cottages, seasonal rentals, garages, sheds, storage areas, and other spaces connected to the property.

items.q: Can you remove large or bulky items from a managed property?
a: Yes. Our team can handle bulky furniture, appliances, mattresses, and other large unwanted items, including removal from inside the property.
